content: EspoCRM Roles: ACL with 4 access levels (No/Own/Team/All) per entity/action, roles merge permissively when a user has multiple. Group Email Accounts (Administration, admin-only setup) are shared mailboxes usable for both send+receive; a role's 'Group Email Account' permission (None/Team/All) controls which users can send from a shared address — fits the EspoCRM-only sales@/roman@ mailbox requirement. Free/Community feature.
